devdoc.details: This contract utilizes a DEPOSIT_BATCH contract to perform multi-token swaps and transfers. It inherits from ReentrancyGuard to prevent reentrant calls.

params._depositBatch: The address of the DEPOSIT_BATCH contract.

deposit((uint256,uint256,address,address.details: Transfers the specified deposit amount from the user to the DEPOSIT_BATCH contract, then calls the multiTokenSwapAndTransfer function.

params.data: A struct containing the following parameters: - _depositToken: The address of the token to be deposited. - _depositAmount: The amount of the token to be deposited. - Other necessary parameters required by the multiTokenSwapAndTransfer function.

devdoc.title: DepositManager

deposit((uint256,uint256,address,address.notice: Deposits a specified amount of tokens into the contract and executes a multi-token swap and transfer.

userdoc.notice: Manages deposits of tokens into the contract and handles multi-token swaps and transfers.
